rule: Cost per frame with the released version of the cavity (with floor relief): numbers of faces (source_faces, result_faces), peak memory, time and disk use, compiled from the step records and memory logs of the runs; nothing was measured anew. views: the 8 viewpoints of the cost table. points: one row per frame folder of blocks B (illumination sun0), C (illumination q0 of each viewpoint; the 10 frames of a viewpoint share one cut mesh) and F; the two rows cr_c0_r1 of block F are second render seeds on the cut mesh of the row before: they repeat its result_faces, disk_case_gb and disk_raw_gb, have a geometry time of 0, no peak memory of the steps chain and display and no label readings; the row frames/f/cr_26120001_p3B/cr_c0 has no label readings. source_faces is recorded for block B only (null in blocks C and F). totals: per block. A row with a source was not built again: its cut mesh and its render are those of the earlier run named there, and its geometry and render readings come from the step records and memory logs of that run. peak_gb: peak memory of the steps chain and display and of the label job; for the label job it is the peak of the whole process tree of the worker (labels_yi_tree). seconds: the label time (labels_yi) runs from the admission of the worker to its end and excludes the wait for a free slot; geometry_pool_wait is the part of the geometry time spent waiting for a free slot. box_table names the cost table of the earlier version of the cavity with a flat floor, which has the same columns and the same 8 viewpoints; its label peak was that of the label job alone, so the two label peaks are close but not the same quantity.
